# Provenance

The headers under `api/` and `upscalers/` are byte-identical to the ones in NotRexed/Hookshot
`third_party/fidelityfx` @ `fab8cb37641714bd839ae83c2a7bc582bedc4d70`, which are AMD's FidelityFX SDK v2.4.0
(`Kits/FidelityFX/api/include`, `Kits/FidelityFX/upscalers/include`), MIT, Copyright (C) 2024 Advanced Micro Devices,
Inc. (`LICENSE.md`). AMD's signed DLLs are not vendored.
